deeper.title: What the price assumes
deeper.text: The price assumes about 1% a year growth in free cash flow for 10 years, then 3% (discount rate 9.8% = 10-year Treasury 4.8% + 5%; base: last 12 months of free cash flow). For comparison, sales grew 250% last year; 105%/yr over 3 years — the market expects a slowdown from its recent pace.

deeper.title: Return on capital
deeper.text: 87% (3 years ago -10%, rising) — each $100 invested in the business (debt + equity, net of cash) earns about $87 a year after tax; return on shareholders' equity 61% (3 years ago -13%).

deeper.title: Signed future revenue
deeper.text: Signed but not yet delivered (remaining performance obligations): $134.0B — about 1.0× the last 12 months of sales; customer prepayments not yet earned (deferred revenue): $13.0B, up from $169M a year ago.

deeper.title: Multi-year view
deeper.text: Sales grew 105%/yr over 3 years and 37%/yr over 5 years; operating margin today 75% vs a 5-year range of -41–75% (median 24%): near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back).
deeper.margin_position: near the top of its range (cycle peak risk: margins this high often fall back)

deeper.title: Cash returned to shareholders
deeper.text: Returned $1.3B to shareholders over the last 12 months ($650M buybacks + $610M dividends) = 0.2% of the company's market value. Share count up 1.8% from a year ago (stock pay outpacing buybacks — dilution).

deeper.title: Analyst estimates
deeper.text: Next year's earnings-per-share estimate $207.76, up 24% in 90 days (up 1% in the last 30); 18 analysts raised, 2 cut in 30 days. This year's earnings-per-share estimate $176.50, up 13% in 90 days; 29 analysts raised, 2 cut in 30 days. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

deeper.title: Vs peers
deeper.text: Compared with 6 peers (WDC, STX, INTC, TXN, ADI, QCOM): sales growth 250% vs a median of 27%; operating margin 75% vs 37%; price/sales 5.9× vs 7.2×.

deeper.title: Where sales come from
deeper.text: By segment, latest year vs a year earlier: CMBU 32% of sales, up 219%; CDBU 28% of sales, up 420%; MCBU 27% of sales, up 209%; AEBU 12% of sales, up 234%; 1 smaller. Source: 10-K XBRL.

deeper.title: Insider trading
deeper.text: Last 90 days: no open-market purchases; sales $84.4M, 83% under pre-set 10b5-1 trading plans. Source: SEC Form 4.

tiles.title: Earnings per share
tiles.sub: +1003% vs a year ago · $74.21 over 12 months (GAAP)
tiles.read: Profit per share grew 1003% vs sales 345%: profits are outgrowing sales, so margins are widening.
tiles.explain: EPS = profit divided by the number of shares. The quarterly figures are the 'adjusted' EPS analysts track (Yahoo); the 12-month figure is the official GAAP number from SEC filings.

tiles.title: Earnings vs forecasts
tiles.sub: last 8 reports · bars = EPS beat (+) or miss (−) vs the average forecast
tiles.read: Beat forecasts 8 quarters running, by growing margins (9% → 20%): analysts keep underestimating it.
tiles.explain: A 'beat' means reported EPS came in above the average analyst forecast. Source: Yahoo (unofficial).

tiles.title: Sales growth
tiles.read: Sales up 345% from a year ago and speeding up (from 196% two quarters ago): demand is strengthening.
tiles.explain: Growth of quarterly sales (revenue) compared with the same quarter a year earlier.

tiles.title: Profit margins
tiles.read: Each $100 of sales leaves $75 of operating profit, up from $26 a year ago: profitability is improving.
tiles.explain: Operating margin = operating profit ÷ sales. Gross margin = what's left after the direct cost of the product.

tiles.title: Free cash flow
tiles.read: Only 69% of reported profit became spare cash, usually because of heavy investment; worth watching.
tiles.explain: Free cash flow = cash from operations minus spending on equipment and buildings: money the company could return or reinvest.

tiles.title: Price vs profits (P/E)
tiles.read: You pay 9× last year's profit (lower than 80% of the last 5 years; below peers' 27); only 3× next year's forecast, so the market expects profits to jump.
tiles.explain: P/E = share price ÷ earnings per share. Forward P/E uses next year's forecast earnings.

tiles.title: Next earnings
tiles.read: Reports Dec 23; analysts expect EPS of $38.29, up 701% from a year ago. It usually moves about 8% the day after, so expect a swing.
tiles.explain: Consensus = the average analyst forecast (Yahoo, unofficial). The typical move is the average size of the stock's next-day move after its last reports, not an options-implied figure.

tiles.title: Company outlook
tiles.read: No numeric outlook was found in the latest earnings release, so the next report carries more surprise risk.
tiles.explain: Guidance = what management says it expects for the next quarter or year, from its 8-K earnings release.
